quests.title: Kanra's Thoughts

dialogue.t: You saw my commission? Have you managed to get 5 Sakura Blooms?
Thank you. You know, since the man I love left to join the war, I've not heard one shred of news...
These days, I worry about him at every waking moment. Only the sight of the Sacred Sakura's blossoms can soothe my mind a little.
The reason is that before he left, he swore on the Sacred Sakura that he would return safely to me.

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Kanra would like to have 5 Sakura Blooms.
